chunks: And Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān narrated from al-Ḥalabī, and Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā from Ḥarīz, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
That he was asked about killing with a stone and with a pellet: is it eaten? He said: "No."

key_terms.الْبُنْدُقِ: pellet or projectile; an implement used in hunting
key_terms.الْحَجَرِ: stone; a blunt object used to kill game
key_terms.قَتْلِ: killing; the manner by which the animal is slain
key_terms.لَا: no; a direct legal negation of permissibility
key_terms.يُؤْكَلُ: is eaten; whether the meat is permissible for consumption

ai.seo_question: Is an animal killed by a stone or pellet halal to eat in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning hunted game killed by means such as a stone or pellet. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that such an animal is not to be eaten, indicating a ruling about impermissible forms of killing game.
